thread:
alex: Quick sync — planning a coordinated version bump across api / runtime / console / sdk. Aim to cut the umbrella release Friday 15:00 PT. Hard cutoff for API schema/contract changes: 09:00 PT Friday. Please ack if you need extra time or have hotfixes.

saira: Ack. API team will freeze non-critical changes by cutoff. Any breaking changes already in flight?

tim: No breaking changes from runtime, just a perf tweak PR that could land if it passes e2e. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/runtime/pull/842 — @saira if that affects API contract?

saira: Quick look — should be backwards compatible (KV cache tweak). If it introduces config flags, we'll call them non-breaking. :+1:

lina: Console: we need one more UI fix for changelog rendering; will try to ship before cutoff but flagging in case it slips. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/console/pull/190

jamal: SDKs — I'll open a patch release for Node & Python after final tag. Plan: bump to 0.14.3, publish patch. I'll need a release artifact from runtime and api tags.

release-bot: Reminder — release checklist created: https://go/release/boards/lease123 (automated)

alex: Thanks. Two coordination asks:
1) Post your final PRs and tag @release-bot for a checklist run.
2) Add a one-line changelog snippet in CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased". Use format:

```
- runtime: improve KV cache handling (non-breaking) — #842 (tim)
- api: validate schema edge case for streaming tokens — #401 (saira)
```

saira: Added changelog line and tagged release-bot. Also opened a tiny PR to bump api version: https://github.com/redwood-inc/api/pull/401

tim: Merged runtime PRs; tagging runtime/v0.14.3

release-bot: Tagging workflow started for runtime/v0.14.3 — build queued

ops-bot: Heads-up — build manifest needs to include sdk-binding-compat matrix. Run `./scripts/generate_manifest.sh --include-sdk`

jamal: Will run manifest after tags are live. Planning to cut SDK publish 30 mins after release tag.

lina: Console change slipped, targetting 11:30 PT. If it misses cutoff, we'll cherry-pick the changelog only.

alex: If console misses, do the cherry-pick approach and open a patch release. We prefer to avoid UI rollbacks during whole-release window.

saira: Quick Q — do we want to lane runtime canary to dedicated first? I can set routing policy if yes.

tim: Yes — canary to Dedicated then Hosted. I'll update rollout policy: canary=10% for 2h.

lina: Confirmed — console will only flip feature flags once canary is stable.

jamal: All set on SDK side, opening patch PRs now. Will comment here with publish links when done.

release-bot: All checks passed for runtime/v0.14.3 — artifacts: https://artifact.store/runtime/v0.14.3

jamal: Published node SDK @npm: @redwood/runtime-sdk v0.14.3 — https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/runtime-sdk/v/0.14.3

alex: Great work team. Final reminder: freeze is enforced at 09:00 PT. If you need to bypass, DM me and cc @saira. Post-release retrospective tomorrow 10:00 PT.

lina: Acknowledged. :thumbsup:

tim: ack

saira: ack

jamal: ack

release-bot: Closing checklist in 1h unless issues reported.
